skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit Kal'tsit wore on her return from Zelgrad; that massive apparatus was never meant to be part of the look.
Everyone is talking about how Kal'tsit has changed—but whatever else, she still looks like a doctor.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Kal'tsit has gradually adapted to using the sarcophagus repair module, and her clothing and equipment have been adjusted to match.
Her life is fragile, and real.
